integration_evidence: The shipped CLI was tested against a private real API server through edit, preview, G-code export and undo.
Native workflow coverage compares desktop command names and arguments with the shared typed catalog, and parses every catalog operation as a CLI command.
Current-session job starts, selection/advisory forwarding, Z jog, runtime overrides, caller-relative file paths and input-file confirmation rejection have CLI integration coverage.
API tests cover native nesting, quality tests, variable text, art libraries, node and image editing, sparse profile updates, undo, preview preservation and concurrent-design rejection.
limits: No physical controller or laser was operated during this validation.
Windows and Linux platform behavior was not tested.
Camera capture and overlay rendering still depend on the desktop frontend bridge.
Physical setup, device-button presses and operating-system UI actions are not established as CLI workflows.
The native field catalog is a typed field reference, not JSON Schema.
Local logs are temporary evidence; this record preserves the results after those logs expire.

release_decision.note: The user confirmed these additional checks are not required for this update. The untested-platform and hardware limits above remain factual.
